# Any scope. Each week (the weekly watcher, after counting the majority): a week ago is the tick before last; every
# four weeks the ring of snapshots moves on (wm_sc_m0 the latest, wm_sc_m13 a year before it).
wm_seatchart_weekly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = wm_sc_init } }
		wm_seatchart_init_effect = yes
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_wk_p_lab value = global_var:wm_sc_wk0_p_lab }

		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m6_s_ruk value = global_var:wm_sc_m5_s_ruk }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m5_s_ruk value = global_var:wm_sc_m4_s_ruk }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m4_s_ruk value = global_var:wm_sc_m3_s_ruk }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m3_s_ruk value = global_var:wm_sc_m2_s_ruk }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m2_s_ruk value = global_var:wm_sc_m1_s_ruk }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m1_s_ruk value = global_var:wm_sc_m0_s_ruk }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m0_s_ruk value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = wm_seats_ruk } value = global_var:wm_seats_ruk } } }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m13_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m12_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m12_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m11_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m11_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m10_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m10_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m9_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m9_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m8_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m8_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m7_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m7_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m6_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m6_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m5_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m5_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m4_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m4_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m3_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m3_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m2_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m2_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m1_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m1_s_grn value = global_var:wm_sc_m0_s_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m0_s_grn value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = wm_seats_grn } value = global_var:wm_seats_grn } } }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m13_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m12_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m12_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m11_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m11_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m10_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m10_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m9_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m9_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m8_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m8_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m7_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m7_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m6_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m6_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m5_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m5_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m4_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m4_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m3_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m3_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m2_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m2_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m1_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m1_s_snp value = global_var:wm_sc_m0_s_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m0_s_snp value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = wm_seats_snp } value = global_var:wm_seats_snp } } }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m13_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m12_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m12_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m11_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m11_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m10_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m10_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m9_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m9_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m8_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m8_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m7_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m7_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m6_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m6_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m5_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m5_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m4_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m4_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m3_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m3_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m2_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m2_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m1_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m1_maj value = global_var:wm_sc_m0_maj }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_sc_m0_maj value = { value = wm_majority_value } }
	}
}

# Any scope. After a general election: the history starts if it hasn't (the old seats stay in it).
wm_seatchart_record_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = wm_sc_init } }
		wm_seatchart_init_effect = yes
	}
}
